reviews.text: Thank you Tony and your crew for the amazing remodel job on our pool!! We are so glad we didn’t fill it in! You changed our old, cold, hard to clean deep diving pool into an oasis of fun!! Our family has used the pool more now after the remodel than the 15 years prior. Tony and his crew were amazing!! Tony was always professional and prompt with everything even with all the extra rain we’ve had this year. I would 100% recommend Tony!! Also the tanning ledge is worth it! The entire family loves it! Thank you again for the awesome job on our pool!!
reviews.author: S Anderson

reviews.text: Never in my life have i been more pleased with a business and their work in my life. The job was done well before the finish date they have given me. To top it all off, the pricing was some of the best in the dfw metroplex. If you’re looking to get your pool plastered this is definitely the company to go with.
reviews.author: Chris Hernandez

reviews.text:
Highly recommended, quality work!
My pool needed plaster, Tile, and mastic all replaced. Hernandez pool plaster was able to replace all three for less than the other quotes I received for just plaster replacement. The work is top quality and I was able to remodel my whole pool within my budget.
If I need any pool work in the future Hernandez pool plaster will be my first call, and I would recommend them to anyone who needs pool remodeling done!
reviews.author: Tristan Charles

reviews.text: This guy does not stand behind his work.I had 3 companies come and look at the work they did and all them didn't even want to service it after the did the replaster.Now he don't even want to come look at the work afterwards but he's quick to come pick up the money to start he's gonna learn the hardware cause he's go na have to pay all that money back
reviews.author: miguel cordova

reviews.text: Great experience with Hernandez Pool! The team was professional, knowledgeable, and thorough. My pool looks amazing, and their customer service was excellent. Highly recommend for top-notch pool Remodeling.
reviews.author: Fernando Becerra

reviews.text: The best pool company ever. Very detailed on their work, beautiful and neat job. They were professional, got the job done and had a fantastic customer service.
reviews.author: Martha Navarro

reviews.text: Very professional work these guys do. Have been and will be recommending Hernandez Pool Plaster for anyone looking for some pool work done.
reviews.author: Xavier

reviews.text: Tony and his crew did an amazing job on our pool we recently built. Our kids will enjoy our pool for many summers to come!
reviews.author: Dylan Melgarejo

data.summary: The Google reviews present a mixed but concerning picture. Seven 5-star reviews from about a year ago are positive but somewhat generic. One 1-star review from the same period raises a serious, specific allegation that the owner does not stand behind his work and refused to inspect it, with a claim that other contractors found the work problematic. The lack of reviews on other platforms and the clustering of all reviews around the same time reduces overall confidence in the review ecosystem. The warranty allegation is a significant red flag.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted within the same timeframe (a year ago)
Generic, repetitive praise in 5-star reviews (e.g., 'professional', 'amazing job', 'highly recommend')
Lack of specific negative details in 5-star reviews beyond general satisfaction

negative_evidence: Negative reviewer claims company does not stand behind work and refused to inspect it
Negative reviewer claims other contractors refused to service the company's work

authentic_signals: One detailed negative review with a specific allegation about warranty/stand-behind-work
Positive reviews mention specific features (tanning ledge) and crew names (Tony)
Positive review mentions comparative pricing and specific work (plaster, tile, mastic)
complaint_patterns: Quality concerns flagged by other contractors
